runtime: existing system Python 3.10 / Torch 2.7.0 / Transformers 4.52.3; CPU only, 4 threads; no deployed service or GPU change
matching: identical model, sequences, order, initial adapters, optimizer and steps; objective token weights only
quality_weighting: 2x text/kind/evidence-alias/applicability value spans, normalized loss; proxy, not a learned correctness reward
relation_weighting: quality weighting plus 2x rules and nonempty consequence labels; empty unknown labels not trained as true empty answers
evaluation_sampling: greedy, same source inputs and output limit for all conditions
completion_rule: Parameter updates/adapter files alone do not prove semantic benefit. Inspect actual generations and committed states, retaining invalid and missing results.
larger_scope: Expand source-reviewed transformations and unseen combinations; this eight-example pilot does not close D4 or prove generalization.
cost: Training/evaluation CPU work and token counts separately reported; authoring/review cost unmetered, not zero.
